title: Looks nice but bench wobbles/parts not made well
text: Looks nice but bench wobbles/parts not made well. The benches wobble a lot. I bought 2 benches and all the crossbars don’t fit the bench correctly ..even with the nails placed. And some of the nail holes don’t align.
